searchText: Does anyone know where I can find the amount of unique beaconchain deposit addresses? Something like https://beaconcha.in/charts/deposits_distribution but more detailled? Maybe the top 100? Perhaps you could use the etherscan API to pull the transactions to the deposit contract? ``` chain=> SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f_eth1_sender) FROM t_eth1_deposits; count ------- 60000 ```
